month_notes: China’s National Day week runs to the 7th and lifts the mainland routes — about a fifth of the daily arrivals. The winter schedule then starts on the 25th, bringing Chiang Mai and Cebu back to the board.
empty_band_note: No international arrivals scheduled in this window

context.text: Tan Son Nhat handled 39.9 million passengers in 2024 and is still Vietnam’s busiest airport. Every international arrival clears Terminal 2, which was built for 13 million passengers a year and now processes around 50,000 entry and exit movements a day — over 61,000 on its busiest. That gap, not a shortage of counters, is what the queue is.
context.source: Airports Corporation of Vietnam, 2024; Thanh Nien, Feb 2026
